title: 12 Best Rooftop Bars in Casablanca
description: Discover Casablanca's best rooftop bars! From chic hotel lounges to vibrant open-air terraces, find the perfect spot for stunning city views, delicious cocktails, and unforgettable nights. Your guide to Casablanca's elevated nightlife.

places.name: The View (Sofitel Casablanca Tour Blanche)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Mojito Royal' while watching the sunset over the Atlantic, paired with their gourmet mini-tagines.

places.name: Sky Bar (Hyatt Regency Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'Casablanca Sling' cocktail, a refreshing twist on a classic, accompanied by their mezze platter.

places.name: Narval Sky Lounge (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Gin Basil Smash' with fresh local ingredients, paired with their delicate seafood ceviche.

places.name: La Terrasse Verte (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Moroccan Mint Julep' for a local twist, along with some traditional Moroccan appetizers.

places.name: Sky 28 (Twin Center)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of fine Moroccan wine (like Domaine de Sahari) and their 'Assortment de Tapas' to share.

places.name: The Rooftop Bar (Mövenpick Hotel Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Mövenpick Sunset Spritz' and a selection of fresh fruit skewers or light Mediterranean bites.

places.name: Seven Rooftop Bar (ONOMO Hotel Casablanca City Center)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their signature cocktails with African-inspired ingredients, like a 'Spice Route Martini', along with their gourmet sliders.

places.name: Roof Top Bar & Restaurant (Hotel Art Palace & Suites)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Old Fashioned' paired with their exquisitely prepared lamb tagine bites or mini pastries.

places.name: Dar El Bacha Rooftop (Anfa Place Living Resort)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing 'Mint Tea Mojito' to complement the sea air, or a glass of chilled Moroccan rosé.

places.name: Le Vertigo (Hotel Golden Tulip Farah Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic 'Margarita' and their crispy calamari, perfect for sharing.

places.name: L'Ambiance Restaurant & Lounge (Hotel Val d'Anfa)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of crisp white wine or a Kir Royale, paired with their selection of artisanal cheeses.

places.name: Buddha-Bar Casablanca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Buddha-Bar Cocktail' or a 'Passion Fruit Martini,' accompanied by a selection of sushi rolls or dim sum.
